records.reason: The source attributes a controlled Raven-matrices improvement to Thirus2016, then explicitly designs an improved conceptual replication of the reported SMART effects and tests WASI Matrix Reasoning in its new randomized sample. That particular nonverbal-matrices finding supplies the empirical link. This support depends on the named design plus original finding and corresponding test together; the intervention-use list or generic IQ agreement alone would not suffice.

source_findings.actual_empirical_test_or_comparison: Original controlled increase on Raven Standard Progressive Matrices maps conceptually to current WASI Matrix Reasoning condition-by-time test. Current study administers no mathematics outcome and does not retest the original completion–mathematical-gain relationship.
source_findings.sections_reviewed: Complete available current primary sources; SMART printed pages1–47 including Methods/Results/Discussion and references plus parsed reference rendering; abstract-only identity enrichment and saved access page. All current coding targets/siblings and scoped prior records.

records.actual_limitations: This is a conceptual finding-level link inferred from the named purpose and corresponding matrix tests; no explicit Discussion sentence compares the current matrix result to Thirus by name. No original-specific outcome approval follows from generic intelligence gains.
